paper_record.title: Time domain Stokes mechanism of pair correlated k gap solitons in nonlinear photonic time crystal slabs
paper_record.abstract: Pair generation in time-varying media is commonly attributed to time reflection at temporal boundaries or to amplification inside momentum k gaps. Here we show that these two processes are connected by the time domain Stokes phenomenon. A finite duration photonic time crystal (PTC) slab provides the necessary Stokes connection between the incident vacuum mode, transient k gap amplification, and time boundary scattering. With Kerr nonlinearity, the otherwise unbounded amplification is arrested, spawning Kerr stabilized k gap solitons. When these solitons cross the exit boundary of the time slab, Stokes induced mode conversion produces a secondary pair generation process, yielding four spatially separated and entangled pulse branches. Detection of a backward propagating light pulse therefore heralds its forward propagating partner. We further propose combined Hanbury Brown Twiss and Hong Ou Mandel measurements to test their nonclassical correlations. These results reveal a link between asymptotic Stokes physics and quantum temporal scattering in PTCs, and suggest a route toward ultrafast heralded quantum light sources.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文揭示了非线性光子时间晶体平板中，克尔稳定的动量带隙孤子在时间边界处的斯托克斯分裂机制及其产生的纠缠光子对。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper reveals the time-domain Stokes mechanism that splits Kerr-stabilized k-gap solitons at temporal boundaries of a photonic time-crystal slab to generate entangled photon pairs.

problem.zh: 线性光子时间晶体动量带隙内的放大模式频率锁定且群速度为零（空间冻结），导致无法直接观测到对关联的传播光子。
problem.en: Amplified modes inside the momentum k-gap of linear photonic time crystals are frequency-locked with zero group velocity, preventing direct observation of propagating correlated photon pairs.

approach.zh: 将有限时间光子时间晶体平板的波动方程映射到软边界艾里模型，结合克尔非线性饱和效应，利用时域有限差分（FDTD）模拟和量子化分析验证孤子分裂及HBT/HOM关联。
approach.en: Mapping the wave equation of a finite-time photonic time-crystal slab to a soft-boundary Airy model, incorporating Kerr nonlinearity, and using FDTD simulations and quantization to analyze soliton splitting and HBT/HOM correlations.

main_takeaway.zh: 光子时间晶体的时间边界散射本质上是一种时域斯托克斯现象，它能将克尔稳定的动量带隙孤子分裂为四个空间分离且相互纠缠的脉冲分支。
main_takeaway.en: Temporal-boundary scattering in photonic time crystals is fundamentally a time-domain Stokes phenomenon that splits Kerr-stabilized k-gap solitons into four spatially separated, entangled pulse branches.

why_it_matters.zh: 它建立了经典波渐近物理与量子时间散射之间的桥梁，为在超快光子学中构建预报式量子光源和进行时空控制提供了新途径。
why_it_matters.en: It bridges classical wave asymptotics and quantum temporal scattering, offering a new route for generating heralded quantum light sources and achieving ultrafast spatiotemporal control.

reason.zh: 首次将时间边界散射与时域斯托克斯现象联系起来，并提出了利用非线性孤子解决带隙模式冻结问题以产生可观测纠缠对的方案。
reason.en: Connects temporal-boundary scattering to the time-domain Stokes phenomenon for the first time, proposing a nonlinear soliton scheme to overcome mode freezing and generate observable entangled pairs.

reason.zh: 该研究紧密承接作者此前在PRL发表的动量带隙孤子工作，且涉及光子时间晶体这一当前凝聚态与光学交叉领域的热点基础理论。
reason.en: The study directly follows the authors' previous PRL work on k-gap solitons and addresses hot fundamental theories in the intersection of photonic time crystals and quantum optics.
